Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the ridge queue naming the lantern that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 5 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
